title: The Hull Field
summary: Ash: thirty-three probe hulls in rows, three paints, one design, the oldest deepest. Walk the three rows (row-accord, row-kindred, row-engram), find the empty berth at the end of ours (newest-hull: ACCORD 12, LEDGER 12), past the berth's relic grid (earlier Accords, half stand down at the handshake). The Archivist counts them from home (thirty-three). Opens Vess.

objectives.text: Walk the first row of hulls
Reach the empty berth at the east end of the first row

notes: after: first-light (whose reward routes Ash), so it starts on arrival. The region holds 18 wrecks in the rows and 2 in the pit; thirty-three accounts for the other 13 as buried under the ash at the west end of the rows. Wrecks have no paint field: the text does the paint.
